notes.title: version 1.3.5
notes.notes:
Hello, runners!

Here's a new patch to improve Speedrun mode with seed behavior : with this update, the seeded run will be more consistent and predictable (if you never die, you get the exact same set of chunks everytime. Dying randomize the level, and winning a level get you back on tracks), so you can compete with opponents or friends and really train for a given seed. Not seeded runs remains unchanged. I hope you will enjoy it!

notes.title: RUN : The World In-between LINUX version is now natively available on Steam!
notes.notes:
Hello Runners! 

We know some of you are using Steam on a Linux OS, so maybe it's a good news for some of you? Hephep wanted to experiment with Steam to provide a Linux native version of the game, and it's a success, you can now play the game without the Proton compatibility setting needed. Tell us what you think of this, was it worth it?

notes.title: Savegames bug fix
notes.notes: - Small fixes about the savegames location that was not the good one, sorry everyone!

notes.title: RUN : The World In-Between - Path of Birds + Speedrun update!
notes.notes:
Hello, Runners, here it is, the Path of Birds! As stated in the previous annoucements, new game mode + new cool stuff for the speedrun mode are here! In addition, the game is on sale, so if you were still hesitating to get it, here’s your chance to get the Definitive Edition of RUN : The World In-Between at the best price! Here is the changelog:


 New game mode: the Path of Birds, wich let’s you get a glimpse of what could happen to the main character at the end of the main game. It’s a unique level with some twists in the game design, we let you discover it by yourself. Share your best time!
 New Steam achievements for the Speedrun mode, Infinite mode and Path of Birds mode.
 Speedrun mode update: you can enter a seed before your run, and you can choose to have the game cutscene or not.
 Bug fixes:

 Some achievements (300 jumps, 1000 jumps for instance) are now correctly triggered
 The ingame time counter is now working properly, no need to use Livesplit for speedrunning the 
game!

notes.title: Content update to be released soon!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40225854/ef810829777ef46e1a042aa97a6a54dbc9cb4bb6.png
[hr][/hr]
Hello, Runners! Long time no see! We are releasing an update on on the upcoming 11th of September. Driven at first by the speedrunning community’s requests, we added some surprise in it to please everyone, so please look forward to it! There’s some new stuff that may get you back into the game! 

You can expect a new game mode, new Steam achievements, important quality of life improvements for the speedrun mode and bug fixes! See you soon in the World In-Between!

notes.title: Update note - May 25th
notes.notes:
RUN : The world in-between v1.2:
- Attempt to fix double pattern bug
- Fixed broken Steam achievements
- Fixed issue with timer when switching from infinite game to speedrun or normal game
- Corrected some translations 
- Really fixed OS language detection this time
- Updated video settings to allow vsync or not and to cap FPS to certain values
- Corrected credits for real
- Corrected spikes hitbox (see steam patch 1.1) 
- Removed Sorghal from the higher difficulties for real 
- Show skip logo faster during end credits 
- Really fixed broken patterns
- Reduce black time during credits slideshow

notes.title: Update Notes - May 5th
notes.notes:
Fixed several patterns with missing collisions or not aligned by 1 pixel 
 Updated/corrected credits text 
 Removed Sorghal from higher difficulties than Normal 
 Fixed some typos and wrong translations in the game texts 
 Show the skip icon when the credits loops 
 Fixed an issue with OS language not detected at first launch 
 Fixed issue allowing player to jump after a dash done from a ledge (making use of coyote time) 
 Solving issue erasing the time in a savefile when quitting throught alt+F4 during a game 
 Added text to show the way for harder difficulties run 
 Forced FPS to 60 max to reduce lag on some high refresh rate screens 
 Fix achievements loading on No-DRM versions (Gog, EGS, Itch.io) preventing players to unlock higher difficulties, speedrun and infinite modes
